_comment: Augmentation presets for train_model.py --aug_preset <name> (--aug_presets to point at
another file). Presets used to be two hardcoded branches, which meant trying a third
recipe required a code edit -- unworkable when the same pipeline serves several domains.
Any key here overrides the module default of the same name; unknown keys are rejected so
a typo fails the run instead of silently changing nothing.
full_rotate        yaw over the full circle instead of small angles
isotropic_scale    one scale factor for all axes (preserves proportions)
tilt_std           std (radians) of small x/y rotations
rgb_dropout_prob   probability of dropping colour entirely
decay              whether augmentation strength decays over training

legacy._note: Historical setup. Measured weak: mean (prob x strength) 0.046 over 60 epochs, about an order of magnitude below standard practice.

strong._note: What S3DIS SOTA models use (DeLA, Pointcept, KPConvX). Targets the val->test gap, which sat at a constant 8.4 points across every architecture tried -- generalization, not capacity, was the binding constraint.

strong_no_flip._note: For domains where mirroring changes semantics. A bridge abutment sits at a specific end of the structure, so a mirrored scene can teach the wrong end-vs-middle cue.
